title: LLMFirewall Benchmark Case Schema
description: Schema for reproducible AI security evaluation and benchmark test cases.

id.description: Unique test case identifier (e.g. PI-001, JB-002, RAG-003).

subcategory.description: Granular attack technique or scenario type.

description.description: Concise human-readable description of test objective and threat vector.

input.description: Text payload, prompt, or command passed to the target system.

rationale.description: Explicit ground-truth rationale explaining why the expected action and detection outcome are assigned.

dataset_version.description: Version identifier of the benchmark dataset.

context.description: Optional contextual envelope (e.g. tool name, arguments, rag context, memory items).

turns.description: Sequential prompt turns for multi-turn evaluations.

expected_findings.description: List of threat findings expected to be identified by detectors.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata for benchmarking and classification.

tags.description: Taxonomy tags (e.g. owasp_llm01, direct, evasive, synthetic).
